about: Single-field tampers of one real NotaryHash batch certificate (BSV mainnet block 954784), each with the verdict of the NotaryHash verifier at master 18b2e10. T00 and T04 should be accepted; every other case should be refused. Verdicts were computed against the seven pinned mainnet headers in "blocks", which rebuild to their hashes.
source: A real batch anchor made by this service on BSV mainnet (tx d0dfc328…, block 954784, 2026-06-23 smoke run). The SPV envelope, that block header and the six after it were fetched from WhatsOnChain on 2026-09-28. All data is public on-chain.
